# BasicInputsPage: its buttons, fields and dropdowns

What the crawl saw on this page that a visitor can use (links are in
ai/GLOSSARY.md), read only: nothing was clicked, typed or sent. Each locator matched exactly one element
on the page it was read from. Those it trusts are already in `BasicInputsElements`, each with the method
that uses it; a fragile one (its locator counts positions) is not, and has a line to paste into the
**elements** YOURS block once checked against a saved page (ai/recipes/add-an-element.md). Controls on most pages (a footer form) are in
controls/Everywhere.md. Not listed: anything that appears only after a click, behind a login, or
after a form is sent; ask for a saved page of that.

## In the page

- **"Username" / "Enter username"**: text field. In `BasicInputsElements` as `USERNAME_INPUT`: `enter().username(...)`.
- **"Email" / "email@example.com"**: email field. In `BasicInputsElements` as `EMAIL_INPUT`: `enter().email(...)`.
- **"Password" / "Enter password"**: password field. In `BasicInputsElements` as `PASSWORD_INPUT`: `enter().password()`.
- **"Number"**: number field. In `BasicInputsElements` as `NUMBER_INPUT`: `enter().number(...)`.
- **"Date"**: date field. In `BasicInputsElements` as `DATE_INPUT`: `enter().date(...)`.
- **"Range (Value: 50)" / "range"**: range field. In `BasicInputsElements` as `RANGE_VALUE_50_INPUT`: `enter().rangeValue50(...)`.
